# 1Claw Muse Connector

The 1Claw Muse Connector exposes the 1Claw platform inside your Muse: ask "is anything waiting on me?", "approve that", "how much is in my agents' wallets?", "what did my agents do today?" — while 1Claw keeps every credential, guardrail and audit trail exactly where it was. The only write is the approval decision; reading secrets or moving funds is impossible by design. Honest heads-up: requires a 1Claw account — niche audience of people running 1Claw agents.
